narration: The gods of Asgard feared the giant wolf Fenrir. They forged heavy iron fetters to bind him. Fenrir shattered the iron chains with a single kick. Dwarven smiths wove the silken ribbon Gleipnir. Tyr placed his right hand inside the wolf's jaws. Fenrir bit off Tyr's hand when the ribbon held fast.
